name: Inge Lehmann
summary: Danish seismologist who discovered the Earth's inner core in 1936.

name: Erik Hjortenberg
summary: Author of the biography and colleague of Inge Lehmann.

name: Harold Jeffreys
summary: British seismologist who corresponded with Lehmann about the inner core.

name: Niels Erik Nørlund
summary: Director of Gradmaalingen and the Danish Geodetic Institute.

name: Beno Gutenberg
summary: Seismologist who determined the depth to the Earth's core.

name: University of Copenhagen
summary: University where Lehmann studied mathematics and received degrees.

name: Newnham College
summary: College in Cambridge where Lehmann studied 1910-1911.

name: Danish Geodetic Institute
summary: Institute where Lehmann was chief of the Seismological Department.

name: Copenhagen
summary: Capital of Denmark, birth and death place of Lehmann.

name: Cambridge
summary: City in England where Lehmann studied.

name: Hamburg
summary: City in Germany where Lehmann studied seismology.

name: P' (1936)
summary: Lehmann's paper demonstrating the existence of the inner core.

name: Inge Lehmann Medal
summary: Award established by AGU in 1996 for contributions to understanding Earth's mantle and core.
